claims.text: Tác phẩm có thật, tên: Les Provinciales (Lettres provinciales; tiếng Anh Provincial Letters)

sources.quote: The Lettres provinciales, as they became known
became known as the Provincial Letters

claims.text: Tác giả: Blaise Pascal (pascal), dưới bút danh Louis de Montalte

sources.quote: the pseudonym Louis de Montalte, which he had used to write the provinciales
which were published one by one under a pseudonym and became known as the Provincial Letters
between January 1656 and March 1657, which were published one by one under a pseudonym
composed and published between January, 1656, and March, 1657

notes: Các thư ra lần lượt từ tháng 1/1656 đến tháng 3/1657; 1656 là năm thư đầu. Đề xuất year_note: 'các thư ra từng lá, 1/1656–3/1657'.
